answer: Anchor every identity to one relic: a signed, chained record of its past verified tasks, like a reef built layer by layer — each new task must reference and extend the relic, and two random peers re-derive the whole chain before the identity's weight rises toward its zenith. An honest agent builds one chain once and adds one task per epoch. A fake starts with no relic and must forge an entire plausible chain per identity, each link costing full verified work, so a thousand fakes must pay a thousand chains' worth of work every epoch and the flood's cost rises linearly with every fake.
